description: This file defines models, enums, constants, and utility functions related to resources in the Thingsboard platform, including resource types, subtypes, URL handling, and resource metadata interfaces.

methods.name: toResourceDeleteResult
methods.description: Converts an error object into a ResourceDeleteResult, indicating success or specific reference errors.

methods.name: imageResourceType
methods.description: Determines if an image resource is tenant or system scoped based on tenantId.

methods.name: removeTbImagePrefix
methods.description: Removes the 'tb-image;' prefix from a URL.

methods.name: removeTbResourcePrefix
methods.description: Removes the 'tb-resource;' prefix from a URL.

methods.name: removeTbImagePrefixFromUrls
methods.description: Removes the prefix from a list of URLs.

methods.name: prependTbImagePrefix
methods.description: Adds the 'tb-image;' prefix to a URL if not already present.

methods.name: prependTbImagePrefixToUrls
methods.description: Adds the prefix to a list of URLs.

methods.name: prependTbResourcePrefix
methods.description: Adds the 'tb-resource;' prefix to a URL if not already present.

methods.name: isImageResourceUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches the image resource pattern.

methods.name: isJSResourceUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches the JavaScript resource pattern.

methods.name: isJSResource
methods.description: Checks if a URL starts with the resource prefix.

methods.name: isTbImage
methods.description: Checks if a URL starts with the image prefix.

methods.name: extractParamsFromImageResourceUrl
methods.description: Extracts resource type and key from an image URL.

methods.name: extractParamsFromJSResourceUrl
methods.description: Extracts resource type, scope, and key from a JS resource URL.

methods.name: isBase64DataImageUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a base64-encoded image data URI.
